How bubble text works

Circled letters are enclosed alphanumerics. Digits map individually, so 10 becomes a circled 1 followed by a circled 0 rather than the single circled-ten character.

Where it helps

Bubble letters are useful for a compact playful label. They take more space than ordinary letters; check narrow mobile profile fields before saving.
